guide.summary: Castle, temples, Nakanoshima museums and family science stops, with okonomiyaki, udon, hotel breakfasts, bakeries and cocktail bars checked against their own websites.
guide.tip: Plan museum days around closures: the Nakanoshima Museum of Art, the National Museum of Art and the Osaka City Museum of Fine Arts close on Mondays, while the Osaka Museum of History closes on Tuesdays.

toolkit.label: Closing days
toolkit.copy: The Nakanoshima Museum of Art, National Museum of Art, Osaka City Museum of Fine Arts and Nagai Botanical Garden close on Mondays (next weekday after a holiday Monday). The Osaka Museum of History closes on Tuesdays, and Bar Castle at Hotel New Otani Osaka closes Mondays and Tuesdays.

toolkit.label: Tickets
toolkit.copy: Tsutenkaku says tickets bought by the day before let you enter at a set time, and Osaka Castle Main Tower sells advance admission through its booking site. Nagai Botanical Garden requires an electronic QR ticket at the North-East Gate.

toolkit.label: Reservations
toolkit.copy: Mimiu's main store takes dinner by reservation only, by phone on weekdays, and is closed Saturdays, Sundays and holidays. Dotonbori Imai takes reservations by phone only, not by email.

toolkit.label: Bar rules
toolkit.copy: Bar Castle admits guests aged 20 and over only and does not allow beach sandals or tank tops. Main Bar Vol de Nuit at Hotel Nikko Osaka adds a 990 yen music fee from 20:00 to 22:30.

guide.dek: Anchor each day on one district, check Monday and Tuesday museum closures, and book Tsutenkaku and any dinner reservations a day ahead.
intro: Start where Osaka began. Osaka Castle Main Tower stands at 1-1 Osakajo, and its own site says you can buy admission tickets in advance through its booking site; its displays on Toyotomi Hideyoshi change about every two months. A short walk away, the Osaka Museum of History opens 9:30 to 17:00 and closes on Tuesdays. From 25 November 2026 to 1 February 2027 its feature display covers Okuda Benjiro, an entertainment impresario of Sennichimae. Further south, Shitennoji and Sumiyoshi Taisha are both active places of worship that keep publishing 2026 notices and seasonal events.

Nakanoshima gathers several museums within a few blocks. The Nakanoshima Museum of Art opens 10:00 to 17:00, closes on Mondays, and runs its NHK Sunday Museum 50th anniversary exhibition until 20 December 2026, alongside Edo painting from the British Museum's Japanese collection from 31 October 2026 to 31 January 2027. Next door, the National Museum of Art stays open until 20:00 on Fridays and opens "Stratified Languages" on 1 December. The Osaka Science Museum charges adults 400 yen for its exhibits, and its last planetarium show starts at 16:00.

For food, Mizuno in Dotonbori serves okonomiyaki from 11:00 to 22:00, and since February 2026 it no longer closes on Thursdays. Dotonbori Imai's main store serves udon from 11:30 to 21:30, closes on Wednesdays and the fourth Tuesday of most months, and takes reservations by phone. Mimiu's main store near Yodoyabashi opens on weekdays only, and dinner there is reservation-only. If you're up early, Kizu Market's shops open from about 6:00, and the market suggests coming between 8:30 and 10:30. It closes on Sundays, holidays and some Wednesdays.

Evenings can be quieter in the hotels. Bar Castle at Hotel New Otani Osaka opens 17:00 to midnight, closes Mondays and Tuesdays, admits only guests 20 and over, and runs the Super Osaka Cocktail Collection from 28 October to 29 November 2026. Main Bar Vol de Nuit at Hotel Nikko Osaka opens from 17:00 on weekdays, with live piano and a music fee from 20:00. For breakfast, SATSUKI opens at 7:00 with a morning buffet, and Cafe Couvert at Imperial Hotel Osaka serves breakfast from 6:30 to 11:00.
summaryCards: Pair Osaka Castle Main Tower with the Osaka Museum of History, then head south to Tsutenkaku, where advance tickets give you a set entry time.
Browse Kizu Market between 8:30 and 10:30, or take the 7:00 buffet at SATSUKI before a Nakanoshima museum opens at 10:00.
Call ahead for Mimiu's reservation-only weekday dinners and Dotonbori Imai, and avoid Monday museum days on Nakanoshima.

limitations: Website review, not a visit or telephone confirmation. Advertised opening, booking and exhibition details do not guarantee availability, and several hotel and museum sites note that hours may change. Kuromon Market and Brooklyn Roasting Company returned TLS errors; Abeno Harukas 300 and Takamura returned HTTP 403; Tennoji Zoo returned HTTP 503; teamLab Botanical Garden Osaka and Universal Studios Japan returned only page titles; and Kaiyukan's hours calendar did not load, so these are not included. Osaka Castle Main Tower is included with medium confidence: its address and advance booking were readable, but its opening hours and any dated 2026 notice were not. Hours were not published on the pages read for Shitennoji and Sumiyoshi Taisha. The Osaka Science Museum's closing-day calendar did not load, Rikuro's closing days are not listed, and Mondial Kaffee 328 lists two different closing times for its Club Ace branch. The Museum of Oriental Ceramics and the Osaka Museum of Housing and Living are closed for works.
